macros.name: hologo
macros.doc: Macro \hologo sets the logo with name ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: Hologo
macros.doc: Macro \Hologo starts the logo ⟨name⟩ with an uppercase letter.

macros.name: hologoDriverSetup
macros.doc: The driver can also be configured after package loading using \hologoDriverSetup, also the way for plain TeX to setup the driver.

macros.name: hologoFontSetup
macros.doc: Macro \hologoFontSetup sets the fonts for all logos.

macros.name: hologoList
macros.doc: Macro \hologoList contains all logos that are provided by the package including variants.

macros.name: hologoVariant
macros.doc: Logo ⟨name⟩ is set using ⟨variant⟩ that specifies explicitly which variant of the macro is used.

macros.name: HologoVariant
macros.doc: \HologoVariant is used if the logo is set in a context that needs an uppercase first letter (beginning of a sentence, . . . ).
